text:
maya: Heads up — CI perf alert hit on PR #2149 after merge. kv_coldpath_fanout_microbench exceeds threshold, blocking rollout.

infra-bot: CI job https://ci.redwood/infrastructure/2149/kv_coldpath_fanout failed (perf-diff). summary:
```
Benchmark: kv_coldpath_fanout
p50: 12.4ms -> 14.5ms (+16.9%)
p95: 28.1ms -> 33.0ms (+17.4%)
unit: tokens/s down 9.2%
diff: +17.2% (threshold +10%)
```

tom: Reproduced locally on linux-x86 docker image with same seed. saw same p95 uplift. :eyes:

liam: Bisect narrowed it to commit 9f3a2b7 (author: jonah) — changes to prefetch slab sizing and batcher window in scheduler.

eva: Quick profile (hotpath sampling) attached, short summary: kernel selection shifted for long-seq cases. excerpt:
```
kernel_selector: chosen="matmul_prefetch_heavy" (score=1.34) vs candidate="matmul_fast" (score=0.98)
kv_cache: warmup_hit_rate 0.86 -> 0.82 (-4.7%)
batcher: average fanout 1.8x higher at seq_len=1024
```

jonah: yep that commit tweaked the slab threshold to reduce memory; we expected prefetch tradeoffs but thought perf impact would be negligible.

maya: This is a rollout blocker — hosted traffic would hit lots of long sequences for some customers. We need a plan: revert or patch.

tom: Reverting 9f3a2b7 locally removes the regression. I ran the microbench 5x after revert, p95 back to baseline.

liam: Proposed plan: open a revert PR, run canary shadow for 2 hours, then merge revert if canary clean. Also add a perf guard to the CI microbench to catch this exact kernel path.

eva: I can add a guard test that pins seq_len=1024 and asserts kernel_selector chooses matmul_fast for the baseline quant profile. Will send change to tests.

jonah: Also adding telemetry: log kernel_selector.choice and kv_cache.hitrate on CI so we get structured diffs next time.

infra-bot: Scheduled canary job: https://ci.redwood/infrastructure/2151/canary (shadow run queued).

maya: @jonah please open revert PR and mark as rollback. @eva please add the perf guard. @tom can you coordinate the canary run once revert PR is up? :thumbsup:

jonah: Opening revert PR now -> https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/2151 (revert of 9f3a2b7). adding description + perf reproducer steps.

tom: I kicked the canary after the revert PR landed in staging, jobs are running.

eva: Perf guard PR coming in 10m, will include the flamegraph snippet and a tighter threshold for p95 on kv_coldpath_fanout.

liam: Postmortem/action items: 1) revert PR, 2) perf guard in CI, 3) add kernel_selector telemetry to nightly perf run, 4) revisit prefetch slab tuning with more microbench variants.

maya: Good. If canary is green in 2h we merge revert to main and re-evaluate. Thanks all.

infra-bot: Canary job finished: green (no regression detected on shadow traffic).

maya: Reverted in main. Notifying releases to hold the rollout until we validate the new patch.

jonah: Follow-up created: https://github.com/redwood/repo/issues/434 — tune prefetch slab with targeted perf tests.

eva: Added perf guard PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/2152 — CI will fail on >10% p95 delta for kv_coldpath_fanout.

maya: Closing thread once the perf guard is merged and the issue is created. Good quick teamwork :party:
